description.value: Alpine Grind is Rossland's favourite coffee shop and eatery, centrally located on the main drag of a town that bills itself as Canada's Mountain Bike Capital, with the legendary 35km IMBA Epic Seven Summits trail system radiating from town. The café serves locally roasted Oso Negro espresso, fresh-baked goods, hearty frittata breakfast bagels, and Neapolitan-style pizzas on select evenings, with seating on a street-front patio and a back deck. It has a second location at Kootenay Boundary Regional Hospital in Trail, and features a rotating gallery of local and regional artwork on its walls.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is comprehensive and active, confirming current operations in Rossland, BC under the name 'Alpine Grind Coffee House & Eatery' (OSM records it as 'Alpine Grind'). The site explicitly confirms gluten-free baked goods made in-house, a vegetarian bagel sandwich option, and online takeout ordering via grindtogo.com. No bike-specific amenities (racks, pumps, charging, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.
